in_arabic.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Arabic root 'al-a' which means 'high' or 'exalted'. It is a common name in the Islamic world and is associated with many notable figures in Islamic history, including the Prophet Muhammad's cousin and companion, Ali ibn Abi Talib.
